product_one_liner.value: Auterion provides a vendor-independent operating system, autonomy software and fleet-management tools that let defense and commercial operators deploy and coordinate drones and other autonomous robots.

named_customers.notes: Auterion explicitly identifies these organizations as defense customers.

hq_location.notes: U.S. headquarters; Auterion also identifies Munich as its European headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts by named engineers cover collision-prevention implementation and visual-inertial navigation in GPS-denied environments.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Computer Vision Engineer posting covers onboard perception, embedded inference and detection-model evaluation/retraining.

model_provider.notes: No named built-in model or hosted AI model provider was established after reviewing public product documentation, AI-related posts, the privacy policy and the subprocessor statement; optional deployable third-party AI software does not establish a provider used by the product itself.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly claims GDPR compliance and safeguards; this is a regulatory-compliance claim, not an independently certified audit.

last_funding.notes: Rheinmetall strategic minority equity investment, announced November 18, 2025; the USD amount was undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 Series B and November 2025 Rheinmetall investment fall within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The complete public board lists 25 roles, including Mission Coordinator, but no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: BeyondLine launched June 2, 2026: a new native remote-operations capability in AuterionOS with automatic 4G redundancy, inside the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Kiran Hebbar announced his new role as Auterion CFO on February 4, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot is named for customer fulfillment and marketing in the subprocessor statement and for architecture/administration in a Revenue Operations Manager posting.
